name: Reconnaissance Mission
oracle_text:
Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, you may draw a card.
Cycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)
blocked_sentences: Cycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)

needs.what: an activated ability that is offered while the card is in its owner's hand, whose cost is mana plus discarding the source card itself (the reminder text's "{2}, Discard this card:"), resolving its effects from the graveyard afterwards
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Two halves are missing. (1) Zone: `legality.available_actions` only walks `state.battlefield` when collecting `ActionKind.ACTIVATE`, and the loader hard-pins activated abilities to `active_zones=(Zone.BATTLEFIELD,)` -- the `active_zones` field (which does accept "hand") is only read for triggered abilities, in `triggers.collect`. So no activated ability can be offered from hand at all. (2) Cost: `CostModel` carries `mana`, `tap`, `untap`, `sacrifice`, `discard`/`discard_selector`, `pay_life`, `remove_counters` and `exile_from_graveyard`; `discard` picks N cards out of `_discard_pool`, which is the hand filtered by `discard_selector`, with no way to name the ability's own source -- `self_only` is a battlefield-object selector key and the source is not a battlefield object here. `discard: 1` alone would let the player pitch any other card and keep Reconnaissance Mission, which is a different and strictly better card than the one printed. Neither card-level alternative fits: `retrace` widens where a card may be *cast* from (graveyard, discarding a land) and `suspend` exiles the card to cast it later -- both still cast the spell, whereas cycling never casts anything and must not put the enchantment onto the battlefield.
